notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed these bugs:
[list][*]Distractible objects thrown outside could cause dog to walk into walls
[*]Sometimes couldn't interact/go through with window after destroying
[*]Tutorial prompts could overlay and show on top of each other sometimes
[*]When pickup golden key before finish falling off parent, would stay bright color + would allow to pickup anywhere
[*]Another bug when picking up objects and finding them in searchable objects
[*]Fixed a couple bugs in the demo version too[/list]
Also Sneak Out is available on Mac now :)

notes.title: Mac Release!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Sneak Out is now available on Mac!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/b1ac893ef55103cfd527400093c1f040a4c44754.png[/img]

notes.title: SNEAK OUT IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Sneak Out is now officially released and I can't wait to share it with you all![/b]

As of now Sneak Out is available to purchase and play on Steam, so you can finally escape from your parents house while being an absolute menace of a child!

There's a 15% launch discount, so I hope you enjoy and reviews are greatly appreciated!
Thank you so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/49a1e8355440954ecac0360b464e6674728dc099.png[/img]

notes.title: Sneak Out releases tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Don't miss the release of Sneak Out on February 15 2024[/b][/h1]
One day to go until Sneak Out launches so make sure to wishlist now!
Release time will be 07:00 PST / 10:00 EST / 15:00 GMT and Sneak Out will launch with a 15% discount.
Looking forward to you being able to play it, thank you!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Over! AND IT'S LAUNCH WEEK!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played the demo in the Steam Next Fest, and from the positive feedback, the demo will be staying up for everyone and anyone who wants to play the game!

And it's also launch week!!! Sneak Out will be releasing this Thursday (on the 15th Feb) so make sure to save the date and wishlist so you know when the game launches with a 15% discount.

Thank you :)

notes.title: One week until Sneak Out releases!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/b1ac893ef55103cfd527400093c1f040a4c44754.png[/img]
Hey everyone, just a reminder that Sneak Out releases in one week today on the 15th February 2024!

Thanks to all those who have played the demo, and just to know, the full game will have 10 escape scenarios, instead of the three that were in the demo.

Consider wishlisting the game if you haven't already so you know when the game releases with the 15% launch discount.

Thanks again :)

notes.title: Sneak Out Demo is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the free Sneak Out demo is out for all who want to try out the game!
The demo is available from Feb 2 - 12 so if your interested make sure to give it go in that time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/b1ac893ef55103cfd527400093c1f040a4c44754.png[/img]
You can put your feedback, suggestions, etc in the Demo Feedback Topic in the Discussions tab of the community tab, I would love to hear them.
Thank you!

notes.title: Sneak Out launches February 15th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Sneak Out will launch on Steam on February 15th 2024, and that's just two weeks away!

How much?
Sneak Out will be $5.99/£5.79/€5,79 and on release day there will be a 7 day 15% off launch discount

If your interested in staying up to date and know when the game launches with the discount, make sure to wishlist :)
Thank you!

notes.title: Sneak Out will be participating in the Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/a90b4db4c8ec81f7dcf3f3cd2841ec71e4a6d8dc.png[/img]
Hey everyone,
So Sneak Out will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest from Feb 5 - Feb 12!
During the time the free demo will be available to anyone who wants to give the game a try
But remember the demo will be going live on Feb 2 (three days before the Next fest begins!)
Thanks again :)

notes.title: Free Demo To Play - Feb 2-12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837311/b1ac893ef55103cfd527400093c1f040a4c44754.png[/img]
Hey everyone,
There will be a free demo for Sneak Out from Feb 2-12 (10 days) for you to try out the game and see what you think!

Thank you for the support and if you want to help out some more, wishlisting the game would mean so much. And the game's release date may or may not be a lot sooner than you think.. (launch date announcement coming soon)
